F1.evidence: The spinners now paint only through data: SVG masks (ui/src/styles/base.css:366-369), and a mask image that a CSP img-src 'self' blocks fails to load, which hides the element. But the Gateway's own policy allows data: (src/gateway/control-ui-csp.ts:120), and the UI already relied on data: masks before this change (components.css:1118, chat/text.css:665), so the failure needs an operator proxy that overrides the Gateway's CSP.
